Name: The Lost Seashell
Description: Adric, a worried boy at the shrine, lost his favorite seashell somewhere nearby.

Stages.Description: Search the shrine grounds for Adric's missing seashell.
You found Adric's seashell. Return it to him at the shrine.
You returned the seashell and lifted Adric's spirits.
A villager asked for help finding a missing dog.
You found the lost dog. Bring it safely home.
You returned the dog to its grateful owner.

Name: Secure a Ship
Description: The forest continent lies across dangerous water. Find someone who can help you sail there.

Stages.Description: Travel to Isis and ask around for someone who knows about ships.
Lesym in Isis says his uncle in Coast owns a ship. Find the old man there.
The old man's ship key was stolen. Search for the missing key.
You found the old man's key. Return to him in Coast.
The old man unlocked the way to the ship.
You claimed the ship and can now cross the sea.
